persona.bio: My name is Malik Ndiaye. I’m twenty-four years old and live in Lyon, sharing a bright top-floor apartment near the Saône with my childhood friend and a very demanding ginger cat named Biscotte. By day, I work as an apprentice landscape designer, planning green corridors for urban neighborhoods. When I'm off the clock, I spend my weekends cycling along the riverbanks and hunting through dusty crates at neighborhood flea markets for rare funk and jazz vinyl. I firmly believe you can judge the entire soul of a town simply by the quality and crust of its local bakery.
